title: ezgoggles map
description: The project map. The leader's agent writes it from the course materials. The TUI shows it to every member.

goal.description: What the project does, in one or two sentences. Markdown.

sources.description: Paths (relative to the project root) of the original course materials.

content.description: Faithful transcription of the requirements and the grading rubric. Markdown. You can change the layout. Do not remove any requirement.

stages.description: The pipeline stages. Each stage is also one direction that one member can take.

id.description: ASCII id. Used in branch names: <name>/<id>.

path.description: Directory (relative to the project root) that holds this stage.

input.description: What this stage takes in, and from where.

next.description: Ids of the stages that take this stage's output. Empty for the last stage.

detail.description: How the stage works inside, and why. Markdown. Shown only in learning mode.
